_readme: Price and category overrides for synced products. Keyed by provider product ID (string). Edit values here to update prices or categories. Keep this file as the single pricing source for storefront syncs now and for future Qikink syncs. Do NOT edit the 'name' fields; they are purely for your reference.

_schema.price: Storefront selling price in INR (integer). Required — set to 0 if unsure.
_schema.category: Optional storefront category override. If omitted, the sync auto-assigns from garment type. Use values like: 'Cult Cinema', 'Music Inspired', 'Comics & Art', 'Trending', 'Everyday Basics', 'Tote Bags'.
